ABOUT NORTHLAND

Your dependable UAE source for building materials.

Northland Building Materials Trading LLC is a UAE-based building materials supplier supporting contractors, developers, maintenance companies, hotels, facility management companies and commercial projects.

Our catalogue covers core building materials, timber and boards, gypsum systems, professional tools, electrical and plumbing products, safety equipment, hardware, paints, waterproofing and construction accessories.

WHAT WE SUPPLY

Built around your project requirements.

From everyday site essentials to professional tools and finishing products, Northland supports construction and maintenance requirements across the UAE.

▦

Building Materials

Cement, sand, blocks, gypsum, aggregates, adhesives, waterproofing and construction chemicals.

⚒

Tools & Equipment

Professional hand tools, power tools, drill bits, cutting accessories and site equipment.

◉

Electrical & Plumbing

Cables, switches, sockets, pipes, fittings, valves, conduits and plumbing accessories.

◆

Safety Products

Helmets, safety shoes, gloves, vests, goggles, masks, harnesses and site safety products.

▤

Hardware & Fasteners

Nuts, bolts, washers, screws, anchors, threaded rods, nails, hinges, brackets and locks.

◈

Paint & Finishing

Interior and exterior paints, primers, enamels, rollers, brushes, sealants, silicone and adhesives.
